Referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs, and in addition to the Committee on the Budget, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts federal employees at the Department of Labor and Department of Veterans Affairs, state employment agencies, and veterans seeking employment and training services.
dimensions.evidence: there shall be transferred to the Secretary of Veterans Affairs all functions performed under the following programs of the Department of Labor, and all personnel, assets, and liabilities

dimensions.assessment: Administrative and organizational restructuring of federal programs without changing underlying benefit eligibility rules for veterans.
dimensions.evidence: This Act shall not affect any proceedings or any application for any benefits... pending on the date of the enactment of this Act

dimensions.assessment: Transfers existing appropriations, funds, assets, and liabilities between agencies and requires the President to include funding requests in the VA budget starting in FY2028.
dimensions.evidence: the President shall include in the President's budget request for the Department of Veterans Affairs for fiscal year 2028... funding requested for the functions

dimensions.assessment: Amends Title 38 of the United States Code, reorganizes agency leadership positions, and consolidates veteran employment specialist programs.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to transfer certain functions of the Department of Labor to the Department of Veterans Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Implements permanent structural changes to federal agency jurisdiction taking effect October 1, 2027.
dimensions.evidence: Effective October 1, 2027, there shall be transferred to the Secretary of Veterans Affairs all functions performed under the following programs

missing_information: The exact cost to implement the transfer and the precise headcount of transferred personnel are not detailed in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: Transfers specific veteran employment and training programs from the Department of Labor to the Department of Veterans Affairs, reorganizing administrative structures, state reporting duties, and personnel management.
